description: Look up an EU tariff code: give a CN (8-digit) or TARIC (10-digit) code and as_of (YYYY-MM-DD, mandatory), optionally origin (ISO country or TARIC country-group code) and direction (import, default, or export). It returns whether the code exists and is declarable on that date (with the declarable codes below it when it is not), and every measure that applies by TARIC's cascade from its parent lines: measure type and name, the duty as published and parsed, origin or destination with its name, exclusions, additional codes (codes only), quota order numbers, legal base, start and end. For the duty on a value use eu_duty_calculator; for the UK tariff use uk_duty_calculator. Codes, measures and rates only: no goods description is served; every answer links the Commission's TARIC consultation for the code's wording. Answers come from one monthly TARIC extraction and as_of must be its reference date (every answer and refusal names it). No VAT, excise or national measures; reference, not advice. Rate-limited: a limit error carries reset_at, the UTC time the allowance resets.

as_of.description: Date the measures are read for, YYYY-MM-DD. Required; must be the reference date of the TARIC extraction the answers come from (a refusal names it).

code.description: CN code (8 digits) or TARIC code (10 digits); spaces and dots allowed. Required.

origin.description: Optional: ISO 3166 country code (e.g. CN) or a 4-digit TARIC country-group code (e.g. 1011). Without it every measure on the code is listed.

name: eu_tariff_lookup
title: EU Tariff Lookup (TARIC)
